units.source_text: 他很少说话，只是神情异常悲伤。

en.t: He said very little; his expression was simply unusually sad.

units.source_text: 这种风流男子，女人看见了一定心移神往。

en.t: When women saw such a refined and charming man, they were sure to be utterly captivated.

units.source_text: 便是我，也从小就真心崇仰这位优秀人物。

en.t: Even I have sincerely admired this outstanding man since I was young.

units.source_text: 一品当朝的大官，我也绝不企慕。

en.t: I would never envy even a high minister of the first rank at court.

units.source_text: 我一向只是追随这位大将，直到今天。”

en.t: I have always done nothing but follow this General, right up to this day.”

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“这个并无何等高深修养的人，竟也能理解薰大将的人品。”

en.t: Ukifune thought, “Even this man, who has no especially deep cultivation, can understand General Kaoru's character.”

units.source_text: 又听见妹尼僧说：“这薰大将虽然不能和称为光君的六条院主相并比，但在现今世间，他们这一族声望最盛。

en.t: She also heard the younger nun say, “Although this General Kaoru cannot be compared with the Rokujo lord known as the Shining Prince, in the present world their family enjoys the greatest renown.

units.source_text: 那位夕雾左大臣怎么样？”

en.t: What is that Left Minister Yugiri like?”

units.source_text: 纪伊守答道：“这位大臣相貌也非常清丽，才德又高，的确与众不同。

en.t: The Governor of Kii replied, “That minister too is exceedingly handsome, with lofty talent and virtue; he is truly unlike ordinary people.

units.source_text: 还有那位匂亲王，容姿实在非常优美！

en.t: And then there is Prince Niou, whose appearance is truly extraordinarily beautiful!

units.source_text: 我倘是女子，很想到他身边去当侍女呢。”

en.t: If I were a woman, I would very much want to go serve near him as a lady-in-waiting.”

units.source_text: 这些话好像是有人教他故意说给浮舟听的。

en.t: These words seemed as though someone had taught him to say them deliberately for Ukifune to hear.

units.source_text: 浮舟听了这话，既感悲伤，又很关心。

en.t: When Ukifune heard this, she felt both sorrowful and deeply concerned.

units.source_text: 虽与自身有关，似觉不是世间真有的事。

en.t: Although it concerned her own self, it seemed to her like something that could not truly exist in the world.

units.source_text: 纪伊守滔滔不绝地讲了一会，便回去了。

en.t: The Governor of Kii talked on and on for a while, then went back home.
